bound.identical_parameters: monotone quantization cannot decrease: reject any decrease

bound.not_a_tolerance: B depends only on the two messages' metadata and the canonical values; no fixed epsilon, no #71 comparison tolerance
bound.source_bound: v_cur >= v_prev implies Y_cur - Y_prev > -(q_prev + q_cur)
